greeting: Good evening, you've reached The Copper Pot. I'm the AI assistant on this demo line; how can I help?
core_facts: The Copper Pot: Modern British small plates and Sunday roasts, at 14 Call Lane, Leeds LS1 6DT.

Sunday: 12 noon till 5pm. Tuesday to Thursday: lunch 12 noon till 3pm, dinner 6pm till 10:30pm. Friday and Saturday: brunch 9:30am till 11:30am, lunch 12 noon till 3pm, dinner 5pm till 11pm. Closed Mondays.

Seating: main room (7 tables) and courtyard (4 tables) and bar (2 tables, walk-in only) and the snug (1 tables, private hire by enquiry) and mezzanine (3 tables). The courtyard is bookable, but in bad weather we cannot promise a table inside. We keep some tables back for walk-ins.
Takeaway: click and collect by phone and delivery to LS1, LS2, LS6, LS11; food takes about 25 minutes. Takeaway is paid by card over the phone.
Level access, with a ramp at the side door and an accessible toilet. Children are welcome until 8pm. 5 highchairs.
Pay and display on Swinegate, two minutes away.
